title: A Ghost for the Debt
author: Rosalind Iversen
blurb: Cyrus Eastwick, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
